description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1 te investuar ne nje godine te re ne Linze, prane Restorant Muraga. Apartamenti ka planimetri te rregullt dhe te ndricuar me drite natyrale.
Organizimi: Ambient ndenje+ gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, verande qe aksesohet nga te gjitha ambientet dhe tualet.
Apartameti eshte i investuar, dhe eshte mje mundesi shume e mire banimi.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 115.4 m2, siperfaqe neto 76.5 m2, siperfaqe te perbashketa 9.5 m2 dhe siperfaqe verande 29.4 m2.
Per me shume informacion apo vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment invested in a new building in Linze, near Muraga Restaurant. The apartment has a regular layout and is illuminated with natural light. Organization: Living room + kitchen, 2 bedrooms, veranda accessible from all rooms and toilet. The apartment is invested, and is a very good residential opportunity. The apartment has a total area of ​​115.4 m2, a net area of ​​76.5 m2, a common area of ​​9.5 m2 and a veranda area of ​​29.4 m2. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
